def main():
    total_chars = int(input().strip())
    input_line = input()

    total_words_in_braces = 0
    max_word_length = 0

    in_braces = False
    current_word = []

    def process_word(word, in_braces, consumer):
        length = len(word)
        if length > 0:
            consumer(length)

    for index in range(total_chars):
        current_char = input_line[index]

        if current_char == '_':
            process_word(current_word, in_braces, lambda w: (
                total_words_in_braces.__iadd__(1) if in_braces else None,
                max_word_length := max(max_word_length, w) if not in_braces else None
            ))
            current_word = []
        elif current_char == '(':
            process_word(current_word, in_braces, lambda w: (
                total_words_in_braces.__iadd__(1) if in_braces else None,
                max_word_length := max(max_word_length, w) if not in_braces else None
            ))
            current_word = []
            in_braces = True
        elif current_char == ')':
            process_word(current_word, in_braces, lambda w: (
                total_words_in_braces.__iadd__(1) if in_braces else None,
                max_word_length := max(max_word_length, w) if not in_braces else None
            ))
            current_word = []
            in_braces = False
        elif current_char.isalpha():
            current_word.append(current_char)

    process_word(current_word, in_braces, lambda w: (
        total_words_in_braces.__iadd__(1) if in_braces else None,
        max_word_length := max(max_word_length, w) if not in_braces else None
    ))

    print(f"{max_word_length} {total_words_in_braces}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
